 French tennis will be especially well represented this Thursday in Paris, with four players in the round of 16. Arthur Fils will close out the day against Taylor Fritz, following the showdown between Carlos Alcaraz and Matteo Berrettini.
 France's Arthur Fils celebrates his victory over Czech player Tomas Machac at the end of their men's singles match on day three of the ATP Masters 1000 Paris tennis tournament at La Plenitude Arena in Nanterre, on the outskirts of Paris, on November 4, 2026. © DIMITAR DILKOFF / AFP Jules Hypolite 04/11/2026, 22:24 1 min to read Follow us Alcaraz Fils Halys Paris Shelton The schedule for the round of 16 at the Rolex Paris Masters is set.
 For the fourth day of competition this week, French fans will have plenty to cheer about, as four French players will be in action on the center court at La Plenitude Arena.
 Remove ads The French in force
 The start of the day will boil down to a France vs. USA showdown, beginning with the matchup between Quentin Halys and Tommy Paul, followed by Arthur Rinderknech taking on Ben Shelton.
 Next up, Luca Van Assche, who knocked out Learner Tien on Thursday , will face Lorenzo Musetti.
 Alcaraz and Fils in the night session
 For the evening session, Carlos Alcaraz and Arthur Fils will once again take center stage.
 The Spaniard faces a tough test against Matteo Berrettini, whom he hasn't played in more than three years.
 Then Fils, who has qualified for the ATP Finals in Turin , will close out the day against Taylor Fritz — the player he retired against last week in Basel.
 On Court 1, three singles matches are on the schedule starting at 2 p.m.: Hijikata vs. Etcheverry, Buse vs. Borges, and Ruud vs. Struff.
